sentences.text: Anna Cooke Kendrick -LRB- born August 9 , 1985 -RRB- is an American actress and singer .
She began her career as a child actor in theater productions .	child actor	child actor

Her first prominent role was in the 1998 Broadway musical High Society , which earned her a Tony Award nomination for Best Featured Actress in a Musical .
